messages.subject: error when editing table recordTable
parts:
Hi,

I tried to graph with activityDensity with the table that is generated with recordTable, but it generates a wrong graph when making any changes to the table.
Is it possible to edit the table (data) that is generated with recordTable to make the correct graph with activityDensity?

Thanks in advance.

Sincerely

Alberto

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: error when editing table recordTable
parts:
Hi Alberto, 
normally you don't need to edit the data in the record table to get the correct graph. Please see the example in ?activityDensity and in vignette 4.

If you're uncertain feel free to share the str() of your record table. Without further information I don't know what the issue is. 
Best regards,
Jürgen
